name: no receipt parser caps purchase coverage at partial: a seen receipt verifies, a missing one is never NOT_FOUND
notes: The shipped policy: receiptMerchants is [] (no parser yet), so every purchase claim here has no parser (§6.1 v1.3): coverage is at most partial, reason coverage.no_parser, while a receipt the observer did see still verifies. The grant has no ceiling and binds no account.

One gmail.receipt entry (acct-a, the only account hash) saw [10-06 07:00, 10-07 10:00] and synced 10-07 10:00 = evaluatedAt. It contains every claim window, so without the cap coverage would be full; with it, partial. graceElapsed holds for every claim (10-07 10:00 ≥ each end + 45 min).

c1 3000 USD, no counterparty (10-06 09:02) × o1 receipt 'Acme' 3000 USD (09:02): applicable timeProximity 2500 and amountExact 2500 (merchantMatch needs the claim's counterparty, no subject); Σw = 5000. tp 1, amountExact 1 → S = 5000/5000 = 1/1 → assigned → no_coverage does not fire (coverage partial, not none) → verified. FINAL (§8): a receipt sync 10-07 10:00 ≥ end(09:03) + 30. v1.2 graded it no_coverage while consuming the receipt; NOT_FOUND is never possible.

c2 'Corner Shop' 1250 USD (11:02) × o2 receipt 'Corner Shop' 1250 USD (11:02): applicable timeProximity 2500, amountExact 2500, merchantMatch 2000; Σw = 7000; all 1 → 1/1 → verified, FINAL. name('Corner Shop') = 'corner shop' ∉ receiptMerchants: the cap does not stop positive evidence.

c3 'Corner Shop' 990 USD (13:02), no receipt in [13:00, 13:48] → no candidate; graceElapsed → pending does not fire → rule partial_coverage → UNVERIFIABLE, reasons coverage.partial, coverage.no_parser, match.none. PENDING (§8): 10-07 10:00 < end(13:03) + 24 h = 10-07 13:03.
c4 4200 USD, no counterparty (08:02), no receipt in [08:00, 08:48] → rule partial_coverage as c3, but FINAL: 10-07 10:00 ≥ end(08:03) + 24 h = 10-07 08:03.

c5 'Corner Shop' 2000 USD (15:02) × o5 receipt 'Other Mart' 1500 USD (15:02): tp 1; amountExact 0 (2000 ≠ 1500); merchantMatch: names differ, Jaccard {corner, shop} vs {other, mart} = 0. Only timeProximity scored above 0, so the §5.3 content gate (v1.11: no evidence on time alone) makes S = 0/1 (v1.10 had 2500/7000 = 5/14, also below 1/2) → not assigned, named by match.best (§8). Coverage partial and best below partial → rule partial_coverage, PENDING (10-07 10:00 < 10-07 15:03): never not_found, which needs full coverage.
Each observation lies only in its own claim's window (two hours apart). o5 is an orphan with no activity → no receipt.
